newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Huta Ferrum prices IPO at PLN 11-14.
newsitem.headline: Polish Huta Ferrum prices IPO at PLN 11-14.

text.p: Polish steel mill Huta Ferrum SA has set the price of its three-million-share initial public offering at between 11 and 14 zlotys, the company said in an abbreviated version of its issue prospectus.

Ferrum, which plans to enter the Warsaw bourse's main market, said the final price would be arrived at through book-building and would be announced no later than two days before the issue starts on February 25.
Large investors are being offered 2.4 million Ferrum shares on February 25 and February 26 while the the small-investor tranche of 600,000 shares lasts from February 25 to March 3.
The firm's 4,314,000 existing shares have also been approved for public trade.
Ferrum said proceeds from the issue would be used largely to increase pipe production.
It said HSBC Investment Bank plc and bank PBR had underwritten the issue for a stand-by fee of three percent.
Ferrum made a net profit of 3.2 million zlotys in 1995 on 161.1 million zlotys in sales.
The prospectus estimates the firm's net to fall to 2.9 million zlotys in 1996 before rebounding to 4.9 million zlotys in 1997.
Ferrum's main shareholders are National Investment Fund No. 1, which has a 33-percent stake, the state treasury, which has 25.1 percent.
